title: Prayer breakfasts and Doug Coe
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Prayer breakfasts and Doug Coe, about unspecified at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I think they had prayer breakfasts and that kind of thing. They they get together and they talk about >> Doug Co.
this guy Doug Coe was the one of the leaders of the family in the '80s, and he would hold this prayer breakfast, and all of the presidents would have to attend the prayer breakfast
tellings.difference: Puts it in the 1980s and says every president had to attend.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Doug Coe, a leader of the Family, holding prayer breakfasts in Washington.

plain: A researcher and author, Peter Levenda, says that a powerful group in Washington, DC held prayer breakfasts where its members would meet and talk, and he links this to a man named Doug Coe. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, adds that Coe was one of the leaders of this group, which he calls the Family, in the 1980s. Michels says Coe hosted a prayer breakfast that every US president had to attend. It is told to suggest a quiet religious network with access to the very top of government.
